title: Progressive Permutation Alignment with Temperature-Controlled Spectral Sharpening
abstract: arXiv:2610.29396v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In implicit neural representations (INRs), 3D signals are encoded directly in network weights, making stable weight-space operations essential. However, permutation symmetry causes independently trained yet functionally equivalent models to appear distant in weight space, often inducing large loss barriers under linear interpolation. Existing neuron alignment methods either commit early to discrete matches and become trapped in inconsistent local optima or rely on computationally expensive gradient optimization over continuous relaxations, both of which are unreliable in challenging cases such as NeRF. We adopt progressive alignment, a layer-wise strategy that follows inter-layer dependencies from input to output. At each layer, a correlation matrix is estimated and aligned with a discrete anchor obtained by the Hungarian algorithm, after which temperature-controlled spectral annealing gradually sharpens the correlation structure toward

translated_title: 带温度控制谱锐化的渐进式置换对齐
translated_abstract: 在隐式神经表示中，三维信号直接编码在网络权重中，因此稳定的权重空间操作至关重要。然而，置换对称性导致独立训练但功能等价的模型在权重空间中相距甚远，在线性插值下常常产生较大的损失障碍。现有的神经元对齐方法要么过早地确定离散匹配而陷入不一致的局部最优，要么依赖于对连续松弛进行计算开销高昂的梯度优化，这两种方法在NeRF等具有挑战性的场景中都不可靠。我们采用渐进式对齐，这是一种从输入到输出遵循层间依赖关系的分层策略。在每一层，估计一个相关性矩阵，并与通过匈牙利算法获得的离散锚点进行对齐，随后温度控制的谱退火逐渐将相关性结构锐化（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种渐进式置换对齐方法，通过从输入到输出的分层对齐策略，结合匈牙利算法的离散锚点与温度控制的谱退火锐化技术，解决隐式神经表示中因置换对称性导致的权重空间模型对齐难题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a progressive permutation alignment method that combines layer-wise alignment from input to output, using discrete anchors from the Hungarian algorithm and temperature-controlled spectral annealing, to address the weight-space alignment problem in implicit neural representations caused by permutation symmetry.
